verdict.rationale: The GitHub description mentions an Agent Management API (beta) that authenticates machine clients via 'deployment-bound OIDC identities,' which suggests some form of scoped, agent-specific credentialing, and there's a general Access Control feature with per-role/per-group overrides. However, there is no detailed documentation showing how to issue or scope least-privilege API credentials per agent, what permissions can be restricted, or how tokens are managed/revoked. Missing for 10: concrete docs on credential scoping granularity, per-agent API key issuance workflow, and independent verification that OIDC identities enforce least privilege.
